definitions.explanation: The process of taking in or soaking up substances.
Taking in and incorporating knowledge, skills, or other abstract things.

notes:
{吸収|きゅうしゅう} means absorption, both physical and metaphorical.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {吸収|きゅうしゅう}する (to absorb)
- {吸収|きゅうしゅう}される (to be absorbed)
- 〜を{吸収|きゅうしゅう}する (to absorb ~)

PHYSICAL USAGE:
- {水分|すいぶん}を{吸収|きゅうしゅう}する (to absorb moisture)
- {栄養|えいよう}を{吸収|きゅうしゅう}する (to absorb nutrients)

ABSTRACT USAGE:
- {知識|ちしき}を{吸収|きゅうしゅう}する (to absorb knowledge)
- {文化|ぶんか}を{吸収|きゅうしゅう}する (to absorb culture)

BUSINESS:
- {会社|かいしゃ}を{吸収|きゅうしゅう}する (to absorb/acquire a company)
- {吸収|きゅうしゅう}{合併|がっぺい} (absorption merger)
